name: Antigravity CLI
description: Run Antigravity CLI operations on connected native devices.

config_fields.label: Default Device ID
config_fields.description: Device to use by default (leave blank for auto-selection)

config_fields.label: Default Timeout (seconds)
config_fields.description: Maximum time to wait for an Antigravity command to complete

config_fields.label: Allowed Working Directories
config_fields.description: Comma-separated list of directories Antigravity is permitted to operate in

config_fields.label: Execution Profile
config_fields.description: Controls default risk tolerance for Antigravity operations

setup_instructions.title: Install the Antigravity CLI
setup_instructions.content: Install the Antigravity CLI on each device. Verify with 'antigravity --version'.

setup_instructions.title: Configure Authentication
setup_instructions.content: If Antigravity requires an API key or token, enter it above. It will be stored encrypted.

setup_instructions.title: Connect a Native Device
setup_instructions.content: Ensure at least one native device is registered and online in the Devices panel.

setup_instructions.title: Test the Connection
setup_instructions.content: Ask an agent to run 'antigravity_check_runtime' to confirm the CLI is reachable.
